summary: Promote ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN flow-input env vars onto the OAuth client fields the refresh path reads.
reason: The generator classifies canonical oauth2_refresh env vars as auth-flow inputs and never maps them to ClientID/ClientSecret/RefreshToken, so env-var-only headless auth 401s out of the box.
validated_outcome: campaigns list --agent succeeds from a sandboxed HOME with only the three env vars set
